About MentorLagbe

Connecting Bangladesh’s Ambitious Students with Exceptional Mentors

Founded with a simple yet ambitious vision: to make quality, verified tuition and mentorship accessible to every student across Bangladesh, from primary school to university levels.

Our Educational Mission

Personalized Mentorship That Transforms Academic Potential

In traditional classrooms, students often struggle to get individual feedback tailored to their pace. Meanwhile, passionate educators from premier institutions (BUET, Dhaka University, Medical Colleges) seek avenues to share their deep conceptual knowledge.

MentorLagbe closes that gap. We provide a transparent platform where credentials are verified, schedules are organized, and learning milestones are achieved together.

What We Stand For

Our Guiding Principles

Every feature and policy on MentorLagbe is designed with student safety, educational excellence, and educator respect at the center.

Academic Integrity

We vet educators rigorously so parents and students can learn with absolute trust and transparency.

Equal Opportunity

Bridging the geographical divide by enabling top mentors from capital universities to teach students in any district online.

Empowering Mentors

Enabling university scholars and professional educators to share their knowledge, earn fair honorariums, and build teaching careers.

Workflow

How MentorLagbe Works

A clear, structured path from your initial search to your first completed tuition batch.

01

Create Your Account

Sign up in under 60 seconds as a Student looking for mentors, or as an academic Tutor eager to post tuition batches.

02

Browse & Discover

Filter verified postings across Bangladesh by syllabus (SSC, HSC, Cambridge, Edexcel, University), subject, and location.

03

Apply & Schedule

Students submit applications specifying preferred timing slots and syllabus notes. Tutors accept or respond directly.

04

Learn & Review

Commence personalized online or in-person sessions. After completing tuition batches, students rate and review their tutors.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about finding tutors, posting tuitions, and managing subscriptions.

All tutors who submit tuition postings undergo an administrative verification process where credentials, university affiliations, and subject backgrounds are reviewed before tuitions are approved for public visibility.
